ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food web shows several organisms, including Seaweed, Small fish, Crabs, Large fish, Sea urchins, Sea otters, and Sharks. There is an arrow pointing from Crabs upward to Large fish, indicating that crabs are food for large fish. Reasoning: If the amount of food available to large fish increases, the large fish population could increase. Since crabs feed into large fish in the diagram, having more crabs could increase the size of the large fish population.
